description: Technical preservation record for the original interactive renderer. The record documents the exact HTML artifact, embedded media, shaders, runtime dependencies, deterministic parameters, interaction, rendering pipeline, integrity hashes and reconstruction requirements.

packaging.reason_not_fully_self_contained: Three.js, OrbitControls and GLTFLoader are loaded from external local files under the js/ directory.

threejs_revision.verification_requirement: Preserve and hash js/three.min.js to identify the exact revision.

purpose: check whether a token is active or burned

texture.duplication_note: The standalone Base64 PNG is byte-identical to the PNG already embedded inside the GLB. The renderer explicitly loads the standalone copy and assigns it to the custom ShaderMaterial.

identity_defining.name: seed
identity_defining.preservation_requirement: must remain unchanged for the same token
identity_defining.renderer_usage_observed: Loaded into NFT_PARAMS but not directly consumed by the supplied shader or generateModeParameters function.

identity_defining.name: mode
identity_defining.preservation_requirement: must remain unchanged for the same token
identity_defining.renderer_usage_observed: selects one of ten vertex-deformation branches

background.algorithm: custom two-dimensional gradient-noise-like function labelled Perlin

rendering_pipeline: Create Three.js scene, perspective camera, transparent WebGL renderer and OrbitControls.
Decode the embedded Base64 GLB into an ArrayBuffer.
Decode and load the standalone embedded Base64 PNG as a Three.js texture.
Compile the embedded GLSL vertex and fragment shaders into a ShaderMaterial.
Load token and conservation data from TzKT when token_id is present.
Apply on-chain mode and personality values to shader uniforms.
Parse the GLB, normalize and center its scene, replace its material with the custom ShaderMaterial.
Advance time, deformation, rotation and scale on every animation frame.
Render the scene continuously and update camera controls.

mandatory_components: the exact HTML artifact or an integrity-verified equivalent
on-chain token parameters for canonical token rendering
technically_replaceable_subject_to_artis: TzKT access layer, provided authoritative on-chain values are preserved

technical_observations: The HTML is not fully self-contained because the Three.js runtime and two helper scripts remain external.
The PNG texture exists twice: once inside the GLB and once as a standalone Base64 string; both decoded copies are byte-identical.
The on-chain seed is loaded but is not directly used by the supplied shader or parameter-generation logic.
Animation increments are frame-based, so speed may vary with display refresh rate and runtime performance.
The background permutation and preview personality values use Math.random and are not deterministic.
The contract address is still a placeholder in the supplied renderer.
